assessment.rationale: Held: an open solution already satisfies the goal as written. A live whole-brain simulation exists and is open source. GitHub returns 107 repositories under brain simulation whose leaders are whole-central-nervous- system Drosophila simulations built on the FlyWire connectome and run live with a body and vision, for example snedea/flybrain (180 stars, 139,000 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons), Lulzx/fly-brain (165,000 neurons in a browser with MuJoCo body) and vaibhavkedarisetti/fruit-fly-lab (https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=brain+simulation+neurons&per_page=10&sort=stars). For humans, The Virtual Brain provides an open whole-brain simulator with a published C++ back end and the Virtual Brain Inference toolkit for whole-brain models (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=%22whole-brain%20simulation%22%20OR%20%22whole%20brain%20model%22%20AND%20%22spiking%20neurons%22&format=json&pageSize=8&resultType=lite), and it is in routine published use, for instance linking TMS-evoked potentials to neurotransmitter changes in depression (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=%22Human%20Brain%20Project%22%20AND%20%28simulation%20OR%20legacy%20OR%20EBRAINS%29&format=json&pageSize=8&resultType=lite). OpenWorm is the honest counterweight: MIT-licensed, with a NeuroML connectome of every C. elegans neuron and a body simulator, while its own site says the project is still working to bring the connectome to life (https://openworm.org/). Honest limit: a cell-resolution, biophysically validated simulation of a mammalian or human brain does not exist, and human-scale open tools are region-level mean-field models rather than neurons; a reframed project naming species, resolution and the recordings the simulation must reproduce would be open work needing its own prior-art basis. As written, with a KPI of one whole-brain simulation, this is not new work.

additionalSearches.finding: 107 repositories; the most-starred are live whole-CNS Drosophila simulations on the FlyWire connectome: snedea/flybrain (180 stars, 139,000 neurons), erojasoficial-byte/fly-brain (67, embodied in MuJoCo), Lulzx/fly-brain (36, 165,000-neuron browser simulation with vision), plus the archived BlueBrain/neurodamus. A live whole-brain simulation is openly available for one species.

additionalSearches.query: whole-brain model and whole-brain simulation literature
additionalSearches.finding: 43 hits centred on open whole-brain modelling infrastructure: TVB C++ as a fast back end for The Virtual Brain (Adv Sci 2026), Virtual Brain Inference for probabilistic inference on whole-brain models (eLife 2025), large-scale layered cortical sheet spiking simulations. Human whole-brain simulation is network-level, not cellular.

additionalSearches.query: Human Brain Project and EBRAINS simulation legacy
additionalSearches.finding: 1,369 hits; the returned sample shows the legacy in use as tooling and multiscale models (The Virtual Brain linking TMS-evoked potentials to neurotransmitter changes in depression, a multiscale Parkinson mouse whole-brain model, a cloud SEEG research platform) rather than any claim of a simulated human brain.

OpenWorm is MIT-licensed with all code, data and models on GitHub, and provides Sibernetic (body and fluid simulator), WormSim in the browser and a NeuroML connectome of every neuron, but the project states it is still working to bring the connectome to life. Open infrastructure, with the whole-nervous-system simulation itself incomplete for C. elegans.
